amends_nothing: this is a new group on a configuration that has already been registered. No window, threshold, contract or shape is changed, and no earlier batch is re-judged
question: at the window where the dose stopped being demonstrable at one repeat, does the matched-prefix saving hold across repeats, and what is its dispersion and its majority sign?

why_this_group.the_gap_it_fills: the dose ladder was measured at one repeat per task, so it can show a direction but not a dispersion or a majority. K=1 is the window to repeat because its group is the cleanest of the three: all three arms pass the strict track on every task and all three answer correctly, whereas the K=0 group's baseline arm failed on one task on its own
why_this_group.what_it_is_not: it is not a re-run of the K=1 dose group and its numbers are never pooled with it. It is a different group with a different experiment id and three times the samples
why_this_group.what_it_may_establish: whether the matched-prefix saving at K=1 is stable across repeats rather than a single-draw result

the_measurement_units_this_round_pins.primary: matched-prefix saving measured in COMPLETE PROVIDER TOKENS: for each task and repeat, the baseline arm's input tokens summed over its first k calls, where k is the number of calls the plugin arm made, against the plugin arm's input tokens over its k calls
reported_alongside: as-paired saving in complete provider tokens, on the whole sample, which a one-sided repair retry can move by about 7 percentage points at one repeat
matched-prefix saving in payload bytes, which is a proxy and not the currency, and is labelled as such wherever it appears
the_measurement_units_this_round_pins.unit_labelling_is_mandatory: every table in the report states its unit. The earlier dose table put a byte-basis figure where a primary reading belonged, which moved a threshold crossing; that mistake must not be repeated
the_measurement_units_this_round_pins.the_threshold_reading_under_the_token_pr: on the dose ladder at one repeat the token-basis matched prefix was 3.76 percent at K=3, 5.73 percent at K=1 and 7.07 percent at K=0: K=1 and K=0 clear the 5 percent line and K=3 does not. That is the reading this group tests at K=1 with repeats
the_measurement_units_this_round_pins.a_field_that_is_void_for_this_round: the persisted v21_window_lines counter is void for any group whose window is below 3, because it was written from the frozen module constant. This group's window is 1, so v21_window_lines must not be cited anywhere; the window is evidenced instead by the pinned configuration module, the gate's three-way assertion and the elision counters

configuration.window: K=1, the same pinned configuration module as the b round
configuration.shape: N3: three development tasks, one distinct view per round, three rounds, each view read exactly once
configuration.matrix: 3 development tasks x 3 repeats x 3 arms = 27 samples

worst_case_arithmetic.frozen_formula: samples x (expected model calls + retry budget per sample) + native samples x max summary calls = 27 x (4 + 1) + 9 x 2 = 153
worst_case_arithmetic.the_runners_own_looser_bound: samples x (max turns + retry budget) + 3 x max summary calls = 27 x (5 + 1) + 3 x 2 = 168
worst_case_arithmetic.floor: both are above this project's 1.3x floor, and the frozen formula is the one the pilot itself checks

configuration.no_resume: --resume and --retry-failed are refused by the frozen runner, and the group is written once
configuration.metering: the runner is given no cost rates by the standing ruling, so estimated_cost stays 0.0 and the cost is converted from tokens

decision_line.capability_confirmed_at_this_window: pooled matched-prefix saving at least 5 percent in complete provider tokens with a majority of per-task pairs positive AND the plugin arm's strict track at or above the baseline on every task AND semantic answer correctness at or above the baseline on every task AND zero render failures, zero truncations and zero dropped fields in the plugin arm
decision_line.what_is_also_reported_without_being_the_: the dispersion of the per-pair savings (standard deviation and range), the count of positive pairs, and the as-paired number
decision_line.quality_traded_for_tokens: any task where the plugin arm's strict track or semantic correctness falls below the baseline, or any render failure or truncation in the plugin arm; stop and report
decision_line.inconclusive: positive but below 5 percent, or mixed signs across the repeats
decision_line.capability_absent: saving indistinguishable from zero, or the engagement counters zero

stop_conditions_hard.rule: if any task shows the plugin arm's semantic answer correctness below the baseline, or the plugin arm's strict track below the baseline, or any render failure or truncation, then stop immediately and report without continuing and without changing the window
stop_conditions_hard.asymmetry_disclosure: if a baseline or native summary arm fails on its own, that is recorded in the group, the group's as-paired figure is marked as not being a mechanism reading, and the matched-prefix figure is the one that speaks
stop_conditions_hard.cap_rule: the cap is this group's own; a group that would exceed 250 requests stops rather than raising the cap

pre_flight_zero_api: the group reuses the K=1 configuration module and the b round's gate artifact, which is valid for it because the gate does not depend on the repeat count or the cap; no gate artifact is rewritten
the group's own arithmetic is asserted at start-up: 27 samples, worst case 168 on the runner's bound, cap 250, margin above 1.3
the runner preserves its own bytes before the paid path and refuses to start if the digest does not match the pinned revision ledger
the manifest and the freeze carry tool_output_disclosure and re_read_visibility, as every group in this round must

reporting_rules.evidence_level: development evidence on tasks that took part in building the configuration: it is never a confirmation, it is never merged with the v16 sealed batch, and it is never pooled with the dose groups
must_report: matched-prefix saving in complete provider tokens per task and pooled, with dispersion and the count of positive pairs, and the arms' call counts annotated per task
as-paired saving in complete provider tokens alongside it, marked wherever a retry made the arms unequal
matched-prefix saving in payload bytes, labelled as a proxy
the strict track and the semantic answer correctness per arm
tool calls and model calls per arm, so a re-read is visible
the mechanism counters and the guard fallbacks, with the window evidenced by the pinned module and the gate assertion rather than by the void counter
requests against the cap, cache fields written, peak or off peak
an explicit statement of what this group cannot show
forbidden_wording: the plugin saves about 12.5 percent of context

next_step_only_on_approval: if this group holds, the integrator has said a K=0 group at three repeats may follow as a separate authorisation. It is not authorised here and must not be started
never_rejudge: the v21 stage 1 attempt -01 and its rerun -01b
the v22 window dose groups k3-k1-k0-pilot-01 and the b round k3b/k1b-pilot-01
